name: Law of Figure/Ground
axiom: A view reads as a figure against a ground, and one edge separates them.
trigger: A dialog opens with no dimmed backdrop, so its text bleeds into the page behind it.

checklist.text: Dim the page under a modal so the dialog is the only thing competing for the eye.
Raise menus and sheets off the surface with one shadow direction, not several.
Keep body text at least 7:1 against its background; the figure needs its ground.
Check a screenshot in grey; if figure and ground merge, contrast is carrying it alone.

antiPattern.violation: A modal opens over a dense page with no scrim, and its copy mixes with the text behind it.
antiPattern.remediation: The modal sits on a dark scrim with one soft shadow, and the page behind recedes.
